releaseNotes: Fixes Notes state synchronization between Text, Pen and Marker modes
Typed text blocks now remain stored and visible after switching tools
Confirmed Ink deletion now remains deleted after switching tools
Notes core reloads the latest persisted note state before every render instead of restoring stale in-memory data
Existing text formatting, positioned text blocks, Pen/Marker layering and deletion confirmations are retained
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
